decision: Choose Cooper-Black-Stencil title at 160 px with exact Roboto support. Warm rounded mass and cut bridges make the word feel materially related to a print exchange, while plain supporting information stays easily recoverable.
revision_reason: Increase title 138 to 160 to give the cut silhouette more presence without changing the information layout.
counterargument: The stencil cue is literal and retro; uncut Cooper-Black is cleaner at small sizes and could suit the community equally well.
score_observations: Memorable tactile-looking title fits a welcoming community studio.
Rounded cut shapes feel playful and confident without distressed military cues.
Title dominates; date and place remain quickly locatable.
Plain Roboto support balances the complex title; relationship is practical rather than stylistically identical.
carryover_candidates: Cooper Black concept proposed in A; punctuated Cooper-Black and Cooper-Black-Stencil exact identities first discovered in B.
carryover_layout: A established a larger single-line title works better than splitting OFF/CUT.
